text.p: Comstock Resources Inc said on Monday it has drilled an infill development well in the Double A Wells field in Polk County, Texas.
Comstock's Alabama-Coushatta No. 7 well was recently drilled to a total depth of 14,751 feet and completed in the Upper Woodbine formation through perforations at 14,544 feet to 14,660 feet.
The well is producing 9,073 thousand cubic feet per day and 982 barrels of condensate per day on a 20/64 inch choke with flowing tubing pressure of 4,700 pounds per square inch.
Comstock owns a 27 percent working interest and is the operator of the new well, it said.
Comstock said it presently is drilling a second infill development well, the Alabama-Coushatta No. 8 well. This well is currently drilling below 10,500 feet, the company said.

Also, recent results from drilling in the area has successfully extended the known productive limits of the Woodbine reservoir and confirmed at least one additional new proved undeveloped location on the Comstock acreage, Comstock said. Comstock plans to start drilling a third infill well before year end, it said.
